questions.question: Source A. Marang Seating makes office and café chairs, buys its timber and fabric abroad, and sells at home and for export. Last year it sold 20,000 chairs at $200 each. Cost of sales was $2,400,000, of which $1,600,000 was timber and fabric invoiced abroad at $1 = 4.00 units. Other operating expenses were $1,200,000, including $150,000 of compliance spending. It owes $1,500,000 at 6%. $1,000,000 of its revenue is exported and $600,000 is sold to government offices and schools. It competes with 40 small workshops and 2 large importers. Define the term 'inflation'. (2 marks)

The home currency moves to $1 = 3.20 units. Calculate the new home-currency cost of the imported timber and fabric, and the percentage by which it has risen. (4 marks)
